speaker: Bobby Chen-Ramirez
cascadeSummary: Filed certified inspection reports for interior wall framing and MEP rough-ins at the Temescal Community Health Center ahead of schedule. Expanded community transparency by posting daily progress photos at the 47th & Telegraph bulletin board as promised to neighbors.

statements.decision: Completed interior wall framing and utility inspections with sign-off
statements.quote: The pharmacist's bulletin board now shows conduit runs instead of lost cat posters. That's how you measure real community engagement.
statements.fullStatement: Temescal Community Health Center construction update: All interior wall framing passed inspection today with zero deficiencies—16" on-center spacing verified, fireblocking installed per spec. MEP rough-in inspections completed for first-floor plumbing and second-floor electrical. The pharmacist's bulletin board at 47th & Telegraph now shows conduit runs instead of lost cat posters—that's how you measure real community engagement. Two-shift crews maintain a 7-day lead on schedule without compromising OSHPD-3 standards.

trackerUpdates.MilestoneNotes: C106: Interior framing + MEP rough-ins inspected/signed off; 7-day schedule lead maintained
